name: Meet Cute: Delivery 🐾
source:
Did you ever get in a situation, where you randomly meet a girl of your dream, and never see her again? A girl on the street, in cafe, or maybe even a delivery girl?
Well, the fortune is on your side today! You dream delivery girl just falls into your arms. Literally.
Find out what happened to her, spend time together and take some care of her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897960/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾经遇到过这样的情况：你偶然遇到了你梦想中的女孩，却再也见不到她了？街上、咖啡馆里的女孩，甚至是送货员？
好啦，今天好运就在你身边！你梦想中的送货女孩就这样投入了你的怀抱。字面上地。
找出她发生了什么事，花时间在一起并照顾她。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897960/]Steam[/url]]
